vacancy.title: Project Lead Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Very strong direct ESTEC Test Centre match: MSc Mechanical Engineering, over 4 years equivalent industrial machine/system design, CAD and drawings, hands-on manufacturing/commissioning, test verification and leading technical modifications with suppliers. Includes facility upgrades, proof-load/acceptance tests and project coordination. Space environmental test facility heritage and formal PM certification are gaps, but certification is only an asset; highly recommended.
